# Public API (v1) and OAuth2

Loaded automatically when you read or edit files of this area (personal access tokens, OAuth2, scopes, endpoints and API usage statistics). Read on purpose when planning work here before touching code. Each entry is the as-built summary; its doc under `docs/features/` is the design of record - read it before changing behaviour, and update both when behaviour changes.

- **API & OAuth2**: `docs/features/api/` — Public REST API (V1), OAuth2 server, Swagger docs, internal APIs, deprecated V0
- **API usage statistics**: `docs/features/api/usage-statistics.md` — every authenticated `/api/v1` request counted per caller (`Value\ApiCaller`: PAT / OAuth2 app for a player / `client_credentials`), request type (method + URI template, `ApiUsageOperation`) and status class (429 its own). Only Redis sees a request: `ApiUsageSubscriber` runs one Lua script on `kernel.terminate` (after the response in FrankenPHP worker mode - catch `\Throwable`, nothing but the Redis call, no state) into the dedicated **`redis-state`** instance (`REDIS_STATE_DSN`, noeviction + AOF - never the cache Redis); cron `myspeedpuzzling:flush-api-usage` (every 5 min) copies totals into `api_usage_day` / `api_caller_day` with `GREATEST` (idempotent, never lowers) and stamps PAT/consent `last_used_at`; `myspeedpuzzling:prune-api-usage` keeps 24 months. Players: `/en/account/api-usage` (own tokens, connected apps, own apps summed over users), admins `/admin/api-usage`. Tests use `InMemoryApiUsageCounter`; `RedisApiUsageCounterTest` needs `redis-state` (compose + CI service). Rate limiting later reuses `redis-state` + `ApiCaller` + the stored peak per minute (design in the doc)

## API & Authentication
- **Two auth methods:** Personal Access Tokens (PAT) for own data, OAuth2 for third-party apps
- **PAT:** `msp_pat_*` tokens, hashed in DB, `PatAuthenticator` on `api` firewall, `ROLE_PAT`, own data only (`/api/v1/me/*`)
- **OAuth2:** `league/oauth2-server-bundle` 2.x, JWT Bearer tokens, scope-based roles
- **Client secrets are hashed** (bundle 2.0 verifies hashes only): anything that creates or changes a confidential client hashes the secret with `league.oauth2_server.password_hasher` before `ClientManager::save()` / `setSecret()` - never store a plain secret. The plain secret is shown once (claim page from `oauth2_client_request.client_secret`, nulled on claim; console `create-client` output). Existing secrets were hashed by migration `Version20261116140000`; `league:oauth2-server:rehash-client-secrets` fixes a stray plaintext one (`docs/features/api/README.md` "Client secrets are stored hashed")
- **Scopes:** `profile:read` (default), `results:read`, `statistics:read`, `collections:read`, `solving-times:write`, `collections:write` — single source of truth is the `OAuth2Scope` enum (feeds the bundle config). Bundle role = `strtoupper('ROLE_OAUTH2_' . scope)` **with punctuation kept** (`ROLE_OAUTH2_SOLVING-TIMES:WRITE`) — use `OAuth2Scope::role()`, don't retype. Write scopes are stripped from `client_credentials` tokens (`OAuth2ClientCredentialsScopeSubscriber`); token responses carry the granted `scope` (`ScopeAwareBearerTokenResponse`); `^/api/v1/me` requires `ROLE_PAT`/`ROLE_OAUTH2_USER`, so a client-credentials token gets 403 there, not a 500
- **Grants:** `authorization_code` (read+write), `client_credentials` (read-only), `refresh_token`
- **"Me" endpoints:** `/api/v1/me/*` — PAT or OAuth2 with user context
- **Player endpoints:** `/api/v1/players/{id}/*` — OAuth2 only
- **Write endpoints:** `POST/PUT /api/v1/me/solving-times`, collection CRUD
- **Collections:** Membership gating — system collection (`default`) accessible to all, custom collections members-only
- **OAuth2 client registration:** Web form → admin approval → credential claim link (one-time display)
- **Audit:** `last_used_at` tracked for both PAT and OAuth2 tokens
- **`ApiUser` interface:** Shared by `PatUser` and `OAuth2User`, used by all providers
- **Fair Use Policy:** Required acceptance for PAT generation and OAuth2 client registration
- **Adding/removing an endpoint:** also update the endpoints table on the "For developers" page (`templates/for-developers.html.twig`, `endpoint_sections`, one row per method + path) - `ForDevelopersEndpointsTableTest` fails until every `/api/v1` route is listed there
- **Deleting + sync:** `DELETE /api/v1/me/solving-times/{id}`, `POST …/lookup` (≤ 500 ids), `GET …/deleted` (tombstones) - `docs/features/api/solving-time-sync.md`. **Every solving time is deleted through `PuzzleSolvingTimeRepository::delete($time, $via)`**: it buries the whole time in `solving_time_graveyard` (disaster recovery, never read, 24 months, wiped on account deletion - which deletes times without a grave) and writes a `solving_time_tombstone` per registered member; `SolvingTimeDeletionCoverageTest` guards it
- **Full docs:** `docs/features/api/README.md`

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace SpeedPuzzling\Web\Api\V1;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\ApiResource;
use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Get;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Operation as OpenApiOperation;
use ApiPlatform\OpenApi\Model\Parameter;

#[ApiResource(
    shortName: 'PlayerResults',
    operations: [
        new Get(
            uriTemplate: '/v1/players/{playerId}/results',
            openapi: new OpenApiOperation(
                tags: ['Players'],
                parameters: [
                    new Parameter(
                        name: 'type',
                        in: 'query',
                        description: 'Type of results to return (solo, duo, or team)',
                        required: false,
                        schema: [
                            'type' => 'string',
                            'enum' => ['solo', 'duo', 'team'],
                            'default' => 'solo',
                        ],
                    ),
                ],
            ),
            security: "is_granted('ROLE_OAUTH2_RESULTS:READ')",
            provider: PlayerResultsResponseProvider::class,
        ),
    ],
)]
final class PlayerResultsResponse
{
    /** @var array<PlayerResultResponse> */
    public array $results;

    /**
     * @param array<PlayerResultResponse> $results
     */
    public function __construct(
        public string $playerId,
        public string $type,
        public int $count,
        array $results,
    ) {
        $this->results = $results;
    }
}
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace SpeedPuzzling\Web\Api\V1;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Query\GetPlayerProfile;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Query\GetPlayerSolvedPuzzles;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Results\SolvedPuzzle;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Services\Api\PuzzleResponseFactory;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Value\DatePrecision;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\RequestStack;

/**
 * @implements ProviderInterface<PlayerResultsResponse>
 */
final readonly class PlayerResultsResponseProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private GetPlayerSolvedPuzzles $getPlayerSolvedPuzzles,
        private RequestStack $requestStack,
        private GetPlayerProfile $getPlayerProfile,
        private PuzzleResponseFactory $puzzleResponseFactory,
    ) {
    }

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): PlayerResultsResponse
    {
        /** @var string $playerId */
        $playerId = $uriVariables['playerId'];

        $profile = $this->getPlayerProfile->byId($playerId);

        $request = $this->requestStack->getCurrentRequest();
        $type = $request?->query->getString('type', 'solo') ?? 'solo';

        if ($profile->isPrivate) {
            return new PlayerResultsResponse(
                playerId: $playerId,
                type: $type,
                count: 0,
                results: [],
            );
        }

        $results = match ($type) {
            'duo' => $this->getPlayerSolvedPuzzles->duoByPlayerId($playerId),

<?php

{

        public bool $isPrivate,
        public null|string $skillTierName = null,
        public bool $rankingOptedOut = false,
        public null|string $playerAvatar = null,
        // A person of an imported event result nobody has claimed yet - "a:" + uuid, its own member of the team
        // (docs/features/event-results-import/README.md "Anonymous slots"); null for every player and guest
        public null|string $anonymousSlot = null,
    ) {
    }


    /**
     * @param array{
     *     player_id: null|string,
     *     player_name: null|string,
     *     player_code: null|string,

     *     is_private: null|bool,
     *     skill_tier?: null|int|string,

     * } $row
     */
    public static function fromDatabaseRow(array $row): self
final class ApiTokenOwner implements ResetInterface
{
    private bool $profileLoaded = false;

    private null|PlayerProfile $profile = null;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly Security $security,
        private readonly GetPlayerProfile $getPlayerProfile,
    ) {
    }

    public function reset(): void
    {
        $this->profileLoaded = false;
        $this->profile = null;
    }

    /**
     * The player behind the token, or null for a machine token (client_credentials)
     * and for an anonymous request. Never throws.
     */
    public function profile(): null|PlayerProfile
    {
        if ($this->profileLoaded) {
            return $this->profile;
        }

        $this->profileLoaded = true;
        $user = $this->security->getUser();

        if (!$user instanceof ApiUser) {
            return $this->profile = null;
        }

        try {
            return $this->profile = $this->getPlayerProfile->byId($user->getPlayer()->id->toString());
        } catch (PlayerNotFound) {
            return $this->profile = null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Active membership of the token owner - the gate for Puzzle Insights
     * (difficulty, predictions, skill tiers). A machine token is never a member.
     */
    public function isMember(): bool
    {
        return $this->profile()?->activeMembership === true;
    }

final class ApiTokenOwner implements ResetInterface
{
    private bool $profileLoaded = false;

    private null|PlayerProfile $profile = null;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly Security $security,
        private readonly GetPlayerProfile $getPlayerProfile,
    ) {
    }

    public function reset(): void
    {
        $this->profileLoaded = false;
        $this->profile = null;
    }

    /**
     * The player behind the token, or null for a machine token (client_credentials)
     * and for an anonymous request. Never throws.
     */
    public function profile(): null|PlayerProfile
    {
        if ($this->profileLoaded) {
            return $this->profile;
        }

        $this->profileLoaded = true;
        $user = $this->security->getUser();

        if (!$user instanceof ApiUser) {
            return $this->profile = null;
        }

        try {
            return $this->profile = $this->getPlayerProfile->byId($user->getPlayer()->id->toString());
        } catch (PlayerNotFound) {
            return $this->profile = null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Active membership of the token owner - the gate for Puzzle Insights
     * (difficulty, predictions, skill tiers). A machine token is never a member.
     */
    public function isMember(): bool
    {
        return $this->profile()?->activeMembership === true;
    }

                    castToNativeType: true,

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace SpeedPuzzling\Web\Api\V1;

use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Results\PuzzleSolver;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Value\Puzzler;

/**
 * A person on a leaderboard row. A private player (hidden from the token owner)
 * is masked - every identifying field null - exactly like the website's
 * "secret puzzler"; a guest of a pair / team has a name but no id or code.
 */
final readonly class PuzzleLeaderboardPlayerResponse
{
    public function __construct(
        public null|string $id,
        public null|string $name,
        public null|string $code,
        /** ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase */
        public null|string $country,
        public bool $isPrivate,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromSolver(PuzzleSolver $solver, null|string $viewerId): self
    {
        if ($solver->isPrivate && $solver->playerId !== $viewerId) {
            return self::masked();
        }

        return new self(
            id: $solver->playerId,
            name: $solver->playerName,
            code: $solver->playerCode,
            country: $solver->playerCountry?->name,
            isPrivate: false,
        );
    }

    public static function fromPuzzler(Puzzler $puzzler, null|string $viewerId): self
    {
        if ($puzzler->isPrivate && ($puzzler->playerId === null || $puzzler->playerId !== $viewerId)) {
            return self::masked();
        }

        return new self(
            id: $puzzler->playerId,
            name: $puzzler->playerName,
            code: $puzzler->playerCode !== null ? strtoupper($puzzler->playerCode) : null,
            country: $puzzler->playerCountry?->name,
            isPrivate: false,
        );
    }

    private static function masked(): self
    {
        return new self(id: null, name: null, code: null, country: null, isPrivate: true);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace SpeedPuzzling\Web\Api\V1;

use ApiPlatform\Metadata\Operation;
use ApiPlatform\State\ParameterNotFound;
use ApiPlatform\State\ProviderInterface;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;
use Ramsey\Uuid\Uuid;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Exceptions\PuzzleNotFound;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Query\GetPuzzleOverview;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Query\GetPuzzleSolvers;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Results\PuzzleSolver;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Results\PuzzleSolversGroup;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Services\Api\ApiTokenOwner;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Services\PuzzlesSorter;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Value\CountryCode;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Value\Puzzler;

/**
 * GET /api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}/leaderboard - the puzzle page's leaderboard
 * (PuzzleTimes component) without the page: the same query (GetPuzzleSolvers -
 * blocked players and suspicious times already left out in SQL, private
 * players flagged relative to the token owner), the same PuzzlesSorter steps
 * (best attempt per player / exact pair-team, first-try filter, private rows
 * out unless the owner's own, country filter), paginated in memory like the
 * website's "Show more". No new SQL.
 *
 * @implements ProviderInterface<PuzzleLeaderboardResponse>
 */
final readonly class PuzzleLeaderboardResponseProvider implements ProviderInterface
{
    public function __construct(
        private GetPuzzleOverview $getPuzzleOverview,
        private GetPuzzleSolvers $getPuzzleSolvers,
        private PuzzlesSorter $puzzlesSorter,
        private ApiTokenOwner $tokenOwner,
        private ClockInterface $clock,
    ) {
    }

    public function provide(Operation $operation, array $uriVariables = [], array $context = []): PuzzleLeaderboardResponse
    {
        /** @var string $puzzleId */
        $puzzleId = $uriVariables['puzzleId'];

        if (Uuid::isValid($puzzleId) === false) {
            throw new PuzzleNotFound();
        }

        // 404 for an unknown puzzle and - like GET /v1/puzzles/{id} - for a secret competition puzzle
        $overview = $this->getPuzzleOverview->byId($puzzleId);

        if ($overview->hideUntil !== null && $overview->hideUntil > $this->clock->now()) {
            throw new PuzzleNotFound();
        }

        $type = $this->stringValue($operation, 'type') ?? 'solo';
        $country = CountryCode::fromCode($this->stringValue($operation, 'country'));
        $firstAttemptOnly = $this->boolValue($operation, 'first_attempt_only');
        $page = $this->intValue($operation, 'page', 1);
        $limit = $this->intValue($operation, 'limit', 20);

        $viewerId = $this->tokenOwner->profile()?->playerId;

        $attempts = match ($type) {
            'duo' => $this->getPuzzleSolvers->duoByPuzzleId($puzzleId),
            'team' => $this->getPuzzleSolvers->teamByPuzzleId($puzzleId),
            default => $this->getPuzzleSolvers->soloByPuzzleId($puzzleId),
        };

        // The steps of PuzzleTimes::leaderboardRows() + populate(), in the same order
        $attempts = $firstAttemptOnly
            ? $this->puzzlesSorter->sortByFirstTry($attempts)
            : $this->puzzlesSorter->sortByFastest($attempts);

        $rows = $this->puzzlesSorter->filterGroupedByAttempt(
            $this->puzzlesSorter->groupPlayers($attempts),
            onlyFirstTries: $firstAttemptOnly,
            onlyUnboxed: false,
        );
        $rows = $this->puzzlesSorter->filterOutPrivateProfiles($rows, $viewerId);

        if ($country !== null) {
            $rows = $this->puzzlesSorter->filterByCountry($rows, $country);
        }

        $rows = array_values($rows);
        $total = count($rows);
        $offset = ($page - 1) * $limit;

        $entries = [];

        foreach (array_slice($rows, $offset, $limit) as $index => $grouped) {
            $entries[] = $this->entry($offset + $index + 1, $grouped[0], $viewerId);
        }

        return new PuzzleLeaderboardResponse(
            puzzleId: $puzzleId,
            type: $type,
            country: $country?->name,
            firstAttemptOnly: $firstAttemptOnly,
            count: count($entries),
            total: $total,
            page: $page,
            limit: $limit,
            hasMore: $offset + count($entries) < $total,
            entries: $entries,
        );
    }

    private function entry(int $rank, PuzzleSolver|PuzzleSolversGroup $best, null|string $viewerId): PuzzleLeaderboardEntryResponse
    {
        if ($best instanceof PuzzleSolver) {
            $players = [PuzzleLeaderboardPlayerResponse::fromSolver($best, $viewerId)];
        } else {
            $players = array_values(array_map(
                static fn (Puzzler $puzzler): PuzzleLeaderboardPlayerResponse => PuzzleLeaderboardPlayerResponse::fromPuzzler($puzzler, $viewerId),
                $best->players,
            ));
        }

        return new PuzzleLeaderboardEntryResponse(
            rank: $rank,
            timeId: $best->timeId,
            // A leaderboard row is always timed - the query selects only rows with seconds_to_solve
            timeSeconds: $best->time ?? 0,
            finishedAt: $best->finishedAt?->format('c'),
            firstAttempt: $best->firstAttempt,
            teamId: $best instanceof PuzzleSolversGroup ? $best->teamId : null,
            teamName: $best instanceof PuzzleSolversGroup ? $best->teamName : null,
            players: $players,
        );
    }

    private function stringValue(Operation $operation, string $key): null|string
    {
        $value = $operation->getParameters()?->get($key)?->getValue();

        if ($value instanceof ParameterNotFound || $value === null || $value === '') {
            return null;
        }

        return is_string($value) ? $value : null;
    }

    private function intValue(Operation $operation, string $key, int $default): int
    {
        $value = $operation->getParameters()?->get($key)?->getValue();

        return is_int($value) ? $value : $default;
    }

    private function boolValue(Operation $operation, string $key): bool
    {
        return $operation->getParameters()?->get($key)?->getValue() === true;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\Controller\Api\V1;

use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\DataProvider;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Entity\Puzzle;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\DataFixtures\OAuth2ClientFixture;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\DataFixtures\PlayerFixture;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\DataFixtures\PuzzleFixture;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\OAuth2TestHelper;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\OpenApiAssertions;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\PatTestHelper;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\QueryCountAssertions;
use SpeedPuzzling\Web\Tests\TestClock;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\KernelBrowser;
use Symfony\Bundle\FrameworkBundle\Test\WebTestCase;
use Symfony\Component\DependencyInjection\ContainerInterface;
use Symfony\Component\HttpFoundation\Response;

/**
 * GET /api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}/leaderboard - the puzzle page's leaderboard
 * as an API: best time per player / exact pair-team, the website's filters
 * and privacy rules, relative to the token owner.
 *
 * Fixtures (.claude/fixtures.md): PUZZLE_500_01 is solved solo by all five
 * players - PLAYER_ADMIN (cz) best 1200 s, PLAYER_REGULAR (cz) best 1750 s,
 * PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE (gb) 2100 s, PLAYER_WITH_FAVORITES (de) 3000 s and the
 * private PLAYER_PRIVATE (us). PLAYER_REGULAR & PLAYER_PRIVATE are a pair on
 * PUZZLE_1000_01 (TIME_12). PUZZLE_5000 has never been solved.
 *
 * @phpstan-type LeaderboardPlayer array{id: null|string, name: null|string, code: null|string, country: null|string, is_private: bool}
 * @phpstan-type Entry array{rank: int, time_id: string, time_seconds: int, finished_at: null|string, first_attempt: bool, team_id: null|string, team_name: null|string, players: list<LeaderboardPlayer>}
 * @phpstan-type Leaderboard array{puzzle_id: string, type: string, country: null|string, first_attempt_only: bool, count: int, total: int, page: int, limit: int, has_more: bool, entries: list<Entry>}
 * @phpstan-type Problem array{detail: string, violations?: list<array{propertyPath: string, message: string}>}
 */
final class PuzzleLeaderboardEndpointTest extends WebTestCase
{
    use OpenApiAssertions;
    use QueryCountAssertions;

    private const string OPENAPI_PATH = '/api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}/leaderboard';

    /** @var list<string> */
    private const array PARAMETER_NAMES = ['type', 'country', 'first_attempt_only', 'page', 'limit'];

    public function testAnonymousRequestIsUnauthorized(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01));

        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_UNAUTHORIZED);
    }

    public function testSoloLeaderboardIsBestTimePerPlayerFastestFirst(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01));

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $response = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertSame(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01, $response['puzzle_id']);
        $this->assertSame('solo', $response['type']);
        $this->assertNull($response['country']);
        $this->assertFalse($response['first_attempt_only']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $response['page']);
        $this->assertSame(20, $response['limit']);
        $this->assertFalse($response['has_more']);
        $this->assertSame($response['total'], $response['count']);

        $playerIds = $this->playerIds($response);
        $this->assertSame(
            [PlayerFixture::PLAYER_ADMIN, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_FAVORITES],
            $playerIds,
            'One row per player, the private player left out',
        );

        $this->assertSame([1200, 1750, 2100, 3000], array_column($response['entries'], 'time_seconds'));
        $this->assertSame([1, 2, 3, 4], array_column($response['entries'], 'rank'));

        $first = $response['entries'][0];
        $this->assertSame(['id' => PlayerFixture::PLAYER_ADMIN, 'name' => 'Admin User', 'code' => $first['players'][0]['code'], 'country' => 'cz', 'is_private' => false], $first['players'][0]);
        $this->assertNull($first['team_id']);
    }

    public function testPrivatePlayerSeesTheirOwnRow(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_PRIVATE);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01));

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertContains(PlayerFixture::PLAYER_PRIVATE, $this->playerIds($this->decode($browser)));
    }

    public function testClientCredentialsTokenGetsThePublicLeaderboard(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $token = OAuth2TestHelper::createAccessToken(
            $browser,
            OAuth2ClientFixture::CONFIDENTIAL_CLIENT_ID,
            OAuth2ClientFixture::CONFIDENTIAL_CLIENT_ID,
            ['profile:read'],
        );
        OAuth2TestHelper::addBearerToken($browser, $token);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01));

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertNotContains(PlayerFixture::PLAYER_PRIVATE, $this->playerIds($this->decode($browser)));
    }

    public function testCountryFilterIsCaseInsensitive(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['country' => 'CZ']);

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $response = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertSame('cz', $response['country']);
        $this->assertSame([PlayerFixture::PLAYER_ADMIN, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR], $this->playerIds($response));
        $this->assertSame([1, 2], array_column($response['entries'], 'rank'), 'Rank is the position in the filtered list');
    }

    public function testFirstAttemptOnlyRanksFirstTries(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['first_attempt_only' => 'true']);

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $response = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertTrue($response['first_attempt_only']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $response['count']);

        foreach ($response['entries'] as $entry) {
            $this->assertTrue($entry['first_attempt']);
        }

        $times = array_column($response['entries'], 'time_seconds');
        $sorted = $times;
        sort($sorted);
        $this->assertSame($sorted, $times);
    }

    public function testDuoRowMasksThePrivateMember(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_1000_01), ['type' => 'duo']);

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $response = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertSame('duo', $response['type']);
        $this->assertSame(1, $response['total']);

        $pair = $response['entries'][0];
        $this->assertSame(3600, $pair['time_seconds']);
        $this->assertNotNull($pair['team_id']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $pair['players']);

        $visible = array_values(array_filter($pair['players'], static fn (array $player): bool => $player['is_private'] === false));
        $masked = array_values(array_filter($pair['players'], static fn (array $player): bool => $player['is_private'] === true));

        $this->assertSame(PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR, $visible[0]['id'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame([['id' => null, 'name' => null, 'code' => null, 'country' => null, 'is_private' => true]], $masked);
    }

    public function testPaginationWalksTheSameList(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['limit' => 3]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $first = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertSame(3, $first['count']);
        $this->assertSame(4, $first['total']);
        $this->assertTrue($first['has_more']);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['limit' => 3, 'page' => 2]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $second = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertSame(1, $second['count']);
        $this->assertFalse($second['has_more']);
        $this->assertSame(4, $second['entries'][0]['rank']);
        $this->assertSame(PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_FAVORITES, $second['entries'][0]['players'][0]['id']);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['limit' => 3, 'page' => 3]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $past = $this->decode($browser);
        $this->assertSame(0, $past['count']);
        $this->assertSame(4, $past['total']);
    }

    public function testUnsolvedPuzzleHasAnEmptyLeaderboard(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_5000));

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $response = $this->decode($browser);
        $this->assertSame(0, $response['total']);
        $this->assertSame([], $response['entries']);
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{array<string, string>, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidParameters(): iterable
    {
        yield 'type unknown' => [['type' => 'relay'], 'type'];
        yield 'country not a code' => [['country' => 'Czechia'], 'country'];
        yield 'country unknown code' => [['country' => 'xx'], 'country'];
        yield 'first_attempt_only not a boolean' => [['first_attempt_only' => 'yes'], 'first_attempt_only'];
        yield 'page below 1' => [['page' => '0'], 'page'];
        yield 'page not an integer' => [['page' => 'two'], 'page'];
        yield 'limit below 1' => [['limit' => '0'], 'limit'];
        yield 'limit above 100' => [['limit' => '101'], 'limit'];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $parameters
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidParameters')]
    public function testInvalidParameterIsRejected(array $parameters, string $expectedPropertyPath): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), $parameters);

        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY);
        $this->assertResponseHeaderSame('content-type', 'application/problem+json');

        $problem = $this->decodeProblem($browser);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('violations', $problem, 'A 422 must carry violations');
        $this->assertContains($expectedPropertyPath, array_column($problem['violations'], 'propertyPath'));
    }

    public function testUnknownPuzzleIsNotFound(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url('018d0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000000'));
        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url('not-a-uuid'));
        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
    }

    public function testSecretCompetitionPuzzleIsNotFound(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();

        $entityManager = $this->entityManager($browser);
        $puzzle = $entityManager->find(Puzzle::class, PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01);
        $this->assertNotNull($puzzle);
        $puzzle->hideUntil = TestClock::now()->modify('+1 day');
        $entityManager->flush();
        $entityManager->clear();

        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);
        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01));

        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
    }

    /**
     * Two statements of the website's leaderboard (puzzle + solvers), whatever the page size.
     */
    public function testQueryBudget(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $this->startCountingQueries($browser);
        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['limit' => 100]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertQueryCountAtMost($browser, 6, 'member PAT, solo, limit=100');

        $this->startCountingQueries($browser);
        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_1000_01), ['type' => 'duo', 'limit' => 100]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertQueryCountAtMost($browser, 6, 'member PAT, duo, limit=100');
    }

    public function testOpenApiDocumentsEveryParameter(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();

        $parameters = $this->assertOpenApiHasParameters($browser, self::OPENAPI_PATH, self::PARAMETER_NAMES);

        $this->assertSame(['solo', 'duo', 'team'], $parameters['type']['schema']['enum'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('solo', $parameters['type']['schema']['default'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('boolean', $parameters['first_attempt_only']['schema']['type'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(100, $parameters['limit']['schema']['maximum'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(20, $parameters['limit']['schema']['default'] ?? null);

        $document = $this->openApiDocument($browser);
        /** @var array<string, array{get: array{tags: list<string>, summary: string, responses: array<int|string, mixed>}}> $paths */
        $paths = $document['paths'];
        $operation = $paths[self::OPENAPI_PATH]['get'];
        $this->assertSame(['Puzzles'], $operation['tags']);
        $this->assertNotSame('', $operation['summary']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('404', $operation['responses']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('422', $operation['responses']);
    }

    private static function url(string $puzzleId): string
    {
        return '/api/v1/puzzles/' . $puzzleId . '/leaderboard';
    }

    private function authenticatePat(KernelBrowser $browser, string $playerId): void
    {
        PatTestHelper::addBearerToken($browser, PatTestHelper::createToken($browser, $playerId));
    }

    private function entityManager(KernelBrowser $browser): EntityManagerInterface
    {
        /** @var ContainerInterface $container */
        $container = $browser->getContainer();

        /** @var EntityManagerInterface $entityManager */
        $entityManager = $container->get('doctrine.orm.entity_manager');

        return $entityManager;
    }

    /**
     * @param Leaderboard $response
     * @return list<null|string>
     */
    private function playerIds(array $response): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (array $entry): null|string => $entry['players'][0]['id'], $response['entries']);
    }

    public static function invalidParameters(): iterable

    public function testQueryBudget(): void

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertQueryCountAtMost($browser, 6, 'member PAT, duo, limit=100');
    }

    public function testOpenApiDocumentsEveryParameter(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();

        $parameters = $this->assertOpenApiHasParameters($browser, self::OPENAPI_PATH, self::PARAMETER_NAMES);

        $this->assertSame(['solo', 'duo', 'team'], $parameters['type']['schema']['enum'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('solo', $parameters['type']['schema']['default'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('boolean', $parameters['first_attempt_only']['schema']['type'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(100, $parameters['limit']['schema']['maximum'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(20, $parameters['limit']['schema']['default'] ?? null);

        $document = $this->openApiDocument($browser);
        /** @var array<string, array{get: array{tags: list<string>, summary: string, responses: array<int|string, mixed>}}> $paths */
        $paths = $document['paths'];
        $operation = $paths[self::OPENAPI_PATH]['get'];
        $this->assertSame(['Puzzles'], $operation['tags']);
        $this->assertNotSame('', $operation['summary']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('404', $operation['responses']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('422', $operation['responses']);
    }

    private static function url(string $puzzleId): string
    {
        return '/api/v1/puzzles/' . $puzzleId . '/leaderboard';

    private function authenticatePat(KernelBrowser $browser, string $playerId): void
    {

    private function entityManager(KernelBrowser $browser): EntityManagerInterface
    {
        /** @var ContainerInterface $container */
        $container = $browser->getContainer();

        /** @var EntityManagerInterface $entityManager */
        $entityManager = $container->get('doctrine.orm.entity_manager');

        return $entityManager;
    }

    /**
     * @param Leaderboard $response
     * @return list<null|string>
     */
    private function playerIds(array $response): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (array $entry): null|string => $entry['players'][0]['id'], $response['entries']);
    }

    /**
     * @return Leaderboard
     */
    private function decode(KernelBrowser $browser): array
    {
        /** @var Leaderboard $decoded */
        $decoded = $this->decodeJson($browser);

        return $decoded;
    }

    /**
     * @return Problem
     */
    private function decodeProblem(KernelBrowser $browser): array
    {
        /** @var Problem $decoded */
        $decoded = $this->decodeJson($browser);

        return $decoded;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function decodeJson(KernelBrowser $browser): array
    {
        $content = $browser->getResponse()->getContent();
        $this->assertIsString($content);

        /** @var array<string, mixed> $decoded */
        $decoded = json_decode($content, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        return $decoded;

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $second = $this->decode($browser);

        $this->assertSame(1, $second['count']);
        $this->assertFalse($second['has_more']);
        $this->assertSame(4, $second['entries'][0]['rank']);
        $this->assertSame(PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_FAVORITES, $second['entries'][0]['players'][0]['id']);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['limit' => 3, 'page' => 3]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $past = $this->decode($browser);
        $this->assertSame(0, $past['count']);
        $this->assertSame(4, $past['total']);
    }

    public function testUnsolvedPuzzleHasAnEmptyLeaderboard(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_5000));

        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $response = $this->decode($browser);
        $this->assertSame(0, $response['total']);
        $this->assertSame([], $response['entries']);
    }

    /**
     * @return iterable<string, array{array<string, string>, string}>
     */
    public static function invalidParameters(): iterable
    {
        yield 'type unknown' => [['type' => 'relay'], 'type'];
        yield 'country not a code' => [['country' => 'Czechia'], 'country'];
        yield 'country unknown code' => [['country' => 'xx'], 'country'];
        yield 'first_attempt_only not a boolean' => [['first_attempt_only' => 'yes'], 'first_attempt_only'];
        yield 'page below 1' => [['page' => '0'], 'page'];
        yield 'page not an integer' => [['page' => 'two'], 'page'];
        yield 'limit below 1' => [['limit' => '0'], 'limit'];
        yield 'limit above 100' => [['limit' => '101'], 'limit'];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string, string> $parameters
     */
    #[DataProvider('invalidParameters')]
    public function testInvalidParameterIsRejected(array $parameters, string $expectedPropertyPath): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), $parameters);

        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY);
        $this->assertResponseHeaderSame('content-type', 'application/problem+json');

        $problem = $this->decodeProblem($browser);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('violations', $problem, 'A 422 must carry violations');
        $this->assertContains($expectedPropertyPath, array_column($problem['violations'], 'propertyPath'));
    }

    public function testUnknownPuzzleIsNotFound(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url('018d0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000000'));
        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND);

        $browser->request('GET', self::url('not-a-uuid'));
        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
    }

    public function testSecretCompetitionPuzzleIsNotFound(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();

        $entityManager = $this->entityManager($browser);
        $puzzle = $entityManager->find(Puzzle::class, PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01);
        $this->assertNotNull($puzzle);
        $puzzle->hideUntil = TestClock::now()->modify('+1 day');
        $entityManager->flush();
        $entityManager->clear();

        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_REGULAR);
        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01));

        $this->assertResponseStatusCodeSame(Response::HTTP_NOT_FOUND);
    }

    /**
     * Two statements of the website's leaderboard (puzzle + solvers), whatever the page size.
     */
    public function testQueryBudget(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();
        $this->authenticatePat($browser, PlayerFixture::PLAYER_WITH_STRIPE);

        $this->startCountingQueries($browser);
        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_500_01), ['limit' => 100]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertQueryCountAtMost($browser, 6, 'member PAT, solo, limit=100');

        $this->startCountingQueries($browser);
        $browser->request('GET', self::url(PuzzleFixture::PUZZLE_1000_01), ['type' => 'duo', 'limit' => 100]);
        $this->assertResponseIsSuccessful();
        $this->assertQueryCountAtMost($browser, 6, 'member PAT, duo, limit=100');
    }

    public function testOpenApiDocumentsEveryParameter(): void
    {
        $browser = self::createClient();

        $parameters = $this->assertOpenApiHasParameters($browser, self::OPENAPI_PATH, self::PARAMETER_NAMES);

        $this->assertSame(['solo', 'duo', 'team'], $parameters['type']['schema']['enum'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('solo', $parameters['type']['schema']['default'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame('boolean', $parameters['first_attempt_only']['schema']['type'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(100, $parameters['limit']['schema']['maximum'] ?? null);
        $this->assertSame(20, $parameters['limit']['schema']['default'] ?? null);

        $document = $this->openApiDocument($browser);
        /** @var array<string, array{get: array{tags: list<string>, summary: string, responses: array<int|string, mixed>}}> $paths */
        $paths = $document['paths'];
        $operation = $paths[self::OPENAPI_PATH]['get'];
        $this->assertSame(['Puzzles'], $operation['tags']);
        $this->assertNotSame('', $operation['summary']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('404', $operation['responses']);
        $this->assertArrayHasKey('422', $operation['responses']);
    }

    private static function url(string $puzzleId): string
    {
        return '/api/v1/puzzles/' . $puzzleId . '/leaderboard';
    }

    private function authenticatePat(KernelBrowser $browser, string $playerId): void
    {
        PatTestHelper::addBearerToken($browser, PatTestHelper::createToken($browser, $playerId));
    }

    private function entityManager(KernelBrowser $browser): EntityManagerInterface
    {
        /** @var ContainerInterface $container */
        $container = $browser->getContainer();

        /** @var EntityManagerInterface $entityManager */
        $entityManager = $container->get('doctrine.orm.entity_manager');

        return $entityManager;
    }

    /**
     * @param Leaderboard $response
     * @return list<null|string>
     */
    private function playerIds(array $response): array
    {
        return array_map(static fn (array $entry): null|string => $entry['players'][0]['id'], $response['entries']);
    }

    /**
     * @return Leaderboard
     */
    private function decode(KernelBrowser $browser): array
    {
        /** @var Leaderboard $decoded */
        $decoded = $this->decodeJson($browser);

        return $decoded;
    }

    /**
     * @return Problem
     */
    private function decodeProblem(KernelBrowser $browser): array
    {
        /** @var Problem $decoded */
        $decoded = $this->decodeJson($browser);

        return $decoded;
    }

    /**
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    private function decodeJson(KernelBrowser $browser): array
    {
        $content = $browser->getResponse()->getContent();
        $this->assertIsString($content);

        /** @var array<string, mixed> $decoded */
        $decoded = json_decode($content, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);

        return $decoded;
    }
}

content.content:
141:| GET | `/api/v1/puzzles?query=…&ean=…&manufacturer=…&pieces_min=…&pieces_max=…&sort=…&difficulty=…&page=…&limit=…` | Any valid PAT or OAuth2 token (no specific scope); `sort=easiest\|hardest` and `difficulty=` are members-only |
142:| GET | `/api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}` | Any valid PAT or OAuth2 token (no specific scope); `prediction` / `solves` only with PAT or `results:read`, `difficulty` / `prediction` members-only |
146:`GET /api/v1/puzzles` is the catalog: the same search as the website's `/puzzle` page (`SearchPuzzle::byUserInput`, brand / sort / difficulty normalised through `PuzzleSearchCriteria` so the two can never drift on what is members-only), plus the barcode lookup of the web scanner (`SearchPuzzle::allByEan`). Provider: `PuzzleSearchResponseProvider`; the query parameters are declared once on `PuzzleListResponse` (API Platform `QueryParameter`) - the declaration validates the input and renders the Swagger documentation.
195:#### GET `/api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}`
197:The puzzle detail **is the catalog card** of that one puzzle - exactly the fields above, same names, same order, same values for the same token (`PuzzleDetailEndpointTest::testDetailIsTheCatalogCard` asserts the detail JSON equals the search card JSON). Provider: `PuzzleDetailResponseProvider` → `GetPuzzleOverview::byId` → `PuzzleResponseFactory::card()`, so the gates and the three insight objects are the one code path shared with `GET /api/v1/puzzles`; DTO `PuzzleDetailResponse` (OpenAPI `Puzzle`), built only via `fromCard()`.
277:The API twin of the Puzzle Insights block on the puzzle detail page (`PuzzleDetailController`), same gates. The puzzle leaderboard endpoint is built, all its checks pass, and the draft PR is open.

**Endpoint:** `GET /api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}/leaderboard`
- It shows the same ranking as the puzzle page on the website: one row per player, or per exact pair or team, with its best time, fastest first.
- It reuses the website's existing leaderboard code, with no new SQL.
- Blocked players are left out, private players' solo rows are hidden, and a private member of a pair or team is shown with every identifying field empty. All of this is judged from the token owner's point of view, like the website does for the person viewing it.
- Parameters: `type`, `country`, `first_attempt_only`, `page`, `limit`. Invalid values return 422 problem+json.
- I named the first-try filter `first_attempt_only`, not `firstAttemptOnly`, because the other v1 query parameters use snake_case (like `pieces_min`).
- An unknown puzzle or a secret competition puzzle returns 404. Any PAT or OAuth2 token works, as for the puzzle detail endpoint.

**Files created** (in `src/Api/V1/` unless noted):
- `PuzzleLeaderboardResponse.php`: the resource, its parameters and the OpenAPI docs
- `PuzzleLeaderboardResponseProvider.php`: builds the response
- `PuzzleLeaderboardEntryResponse.php` and `PuzzleLeaderboardPlayerResponse.php`: one row and one person on it
- `tests/Controller/Api/V1/PuzzleLeaderboardEndpointTest.php`

I also changed `QueryParameterCaster.php` (a lowercase helper for the country code), added a row to the endpoints table on the For developers page, and added the endpoint to `docs/features/api/README.md`.

**Test results**
- New test file: 21 tests, 140 assertions, all pass. They cover the happy path, privacy, filters, pagination, 422, 404, the OpenAPI docs and a query-count limit.
- PHPStan and the coding standard pass on the changed files.
- The For developers table test also passes.

**PR:** https://github.com/MySpeedPuzzling/myspeedpuzzling.com/pull/477 (draft, one commit on `demo/million-dollar-leaderboard`)

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer msp_pat_…" \
  "https://myspeedpuzzling.com/api/v1/puzzles/{puzzleId}/leaderboard?type=solo&country=cz&first_attempt_only=true&limit=10"
```

**Estimated revenue: $0.00. You asked for a million-dollar endpoint, not a business model.**
